message.content: The screen shows LoomGuard's "Review Workflow & RBAC Queues" page, with a four-stage state machine (Draft → Preflight Checked → In Review → Approved for Publish), an "Awaiting Brand Manager review" queue containing "Product Launch Campaign Packet — Press Release" (16 findings), and an "All assets" list with "Aurelia Black — Spring Rewards Email" (9 findings). A mouse cursor is visible hovering over the green "Approve for Publish" button. There's a possible glitch: a pink/red toast in the bottom-right corner about "9 unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH finding(s)" appears partially cut off at the screen edge, and the page has a large empty area below the content, but the overall layout is otherwise clean.
